page_title: BRE 5-3 WOL | Brentford v Wolves 05/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+3' 5 - 3 An amazing individual effort from Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball low into the middle of the goal and makes it 5:3. Mark Flekken was helpless.
90+2' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Brentford players have a reason to celebrate!
90+2' Today's match ends for Kristoffer Ajer who will be replaced by Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford).
90+2' Substitution. Yunus Emre Konak (Brentford) in, Mikkel Damsgaard out.
90+1' The Brentford players halt their celebrations as referee Andy Madley makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' 5 - 2 Fabio Carvalho (Brentford) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the bottom right corner, and thus alter the score to 5:2.
88' Corner kick. Wolves will have an opportunity.
88' The ball goes out of play. Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
87' The foul by Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Andy Madley.
86' A superb shot by Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.

85' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is going to have a crack himself.
83' Flag up against Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
82' It's a throw-in for Wolves.
80' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
77' Substitution. Joao Gomes makes way for Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves).
77' Thomas Frank has decided to substitute Christian Norgaard and he is replaced by Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford).
77' We are about to witness a substitution. Fabio Carvalho (Brentford) is replacing Kevin Schade.

74' Kevin Schade (Brentford) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Sam Johnstone pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
74' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Wolves for a penalty. Play continues.
73' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
70' Andy Madley shows a yellow card to Nelson Semedo (Wolves) for a tough tackle.
69' The ball goes out for a corner. Wolves can continue in their attacking effort.
68' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Carlos Forbs walks off the pitch to be replaced by Goncalo Guedes (Wolves).
67' The ball goes out of play and Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
66' Brentford have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

65' Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the left side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
65' The referee points to the corner flag and Brentford will take a corner.
65' Brentford force a corner. They send men into the box.
62' Wolves keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
60' Referee Andy Madley sees the trip by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Brentford will take a free kick near the side line.
59' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
57' The substitution is prepared. Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andre.
55' Carlos Forbs (Wolves) attempts to discuss the decision with Andy Madley, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
55' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) sees a yellow card from Andy Madley after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

55' That didn't go as planned. Christian Norgaard (Brentford) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the left side of the goal was too weak to get past Sam Johnstone, who easily kept it out.
52' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Mark Flekken easily deals with the threat.
49' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) is caught offside!
48' Brentford will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+2' 4 - 2 A perfectly taken corner kick. Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot into the bottom left corner, increasing the score of today's match – 4:2.
45+1' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brentford.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Kevin Schade (Brentford) is adjudged offside.
42' Craig Dawson (Wolves) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
41' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The linesman signals a throw-in for Wolves.
39' Kevin Schade (Brentford) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
37' Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
35' Brentford are ruled offside.

33' Mario Lemina (Wolves) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
31' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) will take a corner kick.

30' Kevin Schade (Brentford) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Sam Johnstone shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
28' 3 - 2 Christian Norgaard (Brentford) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
26' 2 - 2 Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!
23' Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Andy Madley has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
22' The goalkeeper dives to deny Andre (Wolves), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
20' 2 - 1 Goal! Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Sam Johnstone to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
20' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
20' Referee Andy Madley awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

19' Play continues despite the shouts by some Brentford players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Andy Madley interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
17' PENALTY APPEAL by Brentford, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
16' Good work from Brentford as they win a corner.
15' A clumsy foul by Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) and Andy Madley blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Brentford.
13' Dangerous play by Christian Norgaard (Brentford). Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.

10' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
7' The referee signals a corner kick to Brentford.
6' Brentford will take a corner kick.
6' Surely that's handball by one of the Wolves players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
4' 1 - 1 Matheus Cunha (Wolves) latches on to a superb pass and breaks through the defence before firing a shot from mid-range that goes past the goalkeeper inside the right post.

3' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Sam Johnstone pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
2' 1 - 0 Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the right post. Excellent finish.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Brentford will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Andy Madley.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
